title: Cloud Impermanence – Rising Form
statement:
Cloud forms rise, dissolve, and gather again in a continuous upward movement. Light travels vertically through vapor — soft rose, pale aquamarine, muted gold, and deep blue unfolding like breath moving through space. There is no climax and no fixed horizon. Only subtle transformation. The work reflects impermanence not as loss, but as quiet evolution.

Presence is not performed — it is felt.
